insight: chrome-devtools MCP attaches to Chrome Beta and fails unless it runs with remote debugging. Fallback: chrome.exe --headless=new --screenshot. On Windows the headless window will not go below ~500px wide, so check 375px by rendering the page inside a 375px iframe and comparing scrollWidth to clientWidth.

python3 on this machine is the Windows Store stub (exits 49). Serve preview pages with a small Node http server instead. Inlining vendor/pretext.js into the page's module needs its minified export aliases (e.g. X1 as prepare) mapped to an object, since inline code can't import from itself.

When shrink-wrapping a chat bubble with Pretext, don't take the meta line's width from scrollWidth on a block element: it returns the container width and stops the bubble shrinking. Measure the text with a Range's getBoundingClientRect.
